definitions.explanation: A stage performance or theater production.
A false display of emotion or behavior.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{芝居|しばい}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a play on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{涙|なみだ}は{芝居|しばい}だった。
examples.english: His tears were just an act.

examples.japanese: この{劇団|げきだん}の{芝居|しばい}は{評判|ひょうばん}が{良|よ}く、いつも{満席|まんせき}になる。{今回|こんかい}の{公演|こうえん}のチケットも{発売|はつばい}{日|び}に{完売|かんばい}した。
examples.english: This theater company's plays have a good reputation and are always sold out. Tickets for this performance also sold out on the day they went on sale.

examples.japanese: {芝居|しばい}をするのはやめてほしい。
examples.english: I want you to stop putting on an act.
examples.notes: {芝居|しばい}をする = to put on an act, to pretend

examples.japanese: {下手|へた}な{芝居|しばい}はすぐにばれる。
examples.english: Bad acting is quickly found out.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{病気|びょうき}の{芝居|しばい}をして{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: She pretended to be sick and skipped school.

notes:
{芝居|しばい} originally referred to theatrical performances, but it's also commonly used to mean fake behavior or pretense.

MEANING 1 - THEATER:
- {芝居|しばい}を{見|み}る (to watch a play)
- {芝居|しばい}を{打|う}つ (to put on a play)
- {芝居小屋|しばいごや} (theater, playhouse)

MEANING 2 - ACT/PRETENSE:
- {芝居|しばい}をする (to put on an act)
- {猿|さる}{芝居|しばい} (monkey business, transparent trick)
- {下手|へた}な{芝居|しばい} (bad acting, unconvincing act)

RELATED TERMS:
- {演劇|えんげき} (drama, theater - more formal)
- {劇|げき} (drama, play)
- {歌舞伎|かぶき} (kabuki)
- {役者|やくしゃ} (actor)
